aaron.title: Aaron
aaron.about: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
aaron.note: Moses's older brother, and the one God sent to do the talking when Moses said he could not. He became Israel's first high priest, and the priesthood ran through his sons after him. Most of the time he is standing next to Moses.

abijah.title: Abijah
abijah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
abijah.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

abraham.title: Abraham
abraham.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
abraham.note: God called him out of Ur and he went at seventy-five, which is most of what you need to know about him. The nation came out of that.

abram.title: Abram
abram.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
abram.note: Abraham's name before God changed it, in the covenant of Genesis 17. Same man, earlier chapters.

addon.title: Addon
addon.note: Named among the returning exiles who could not produce proof of Israelite descent when the family records were checked.

adin.title: Adin
adin.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
adin.note: Head of a family among the returning exiles, big enough that both Ezra and Nehemiah count the household.

adin-2.title: Adin
adin-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
adin-2.note: The same family name again. It gets one verse in Nehemiah.

adonijah-3.title: Adonijah
adonijah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
adonijah-3.note: One of 3 men called Adonijah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

adonikam.title: Adonikam
adonikam.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
adonikam.note: The census of returning exiles counts 666 men of his family in Ezra. Nehemiah's copy of the same list says 667, which is the kind of disagreement these two registers have all the way through.

ahiah-3.title: Ahiah
ahiah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ahiah-3.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

ai.title: Ai
ai.note: A fortified Canaanite city near Bethel. Israel's first attack was thrown back because of Achan's hidden sin, and once that was dealt with Joshua took the city by ambush. The site is usually identified with et-Tell, though digging there has turned up little from the right period.

akkub.title: Akkub
akkub.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
akkub.note: The name keeps turning up among the Levites, gatekeepers and temple servants who came back from exile, in Ezra and Nehemiah alike.

akkub-4.title: Akkub
akkub-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
akkub-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

amariah.title: Amariah
amariah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
amariah.note: One of several priests called Amariah, this one in Nehemiah's lists at 10:3 and 12:2.

amon.title: Amon
amon.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
amon.note: The son of Manasseh. He followed his father's early idolatry and never turned back, and his own officials killed him after two years. The people executed the plotters and made his young son Josiah king.

amorite.title: Amorite
amorite.note: One of the peoples in Canaan before Israel came, traced in Genesis 10 to a son of Canaan, and sometimes used loosely for everyone in the hill country. Sihon and Og ruled an Amorite kingdom east of the Jordan that fell to Israel under Moses. Outside the Bible they are the Amurru of Mesopotamian texts, the people whose dynasty produced Hammurabi of Babylon.

anaiah.title: Anaiah
anaiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
anaiah.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

anaiah-2.title: Anaiah
anaiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
anaiah-2.note: When Ezra read the law to Jerusalem from a wooden platform, Anaiah stood at his right hand. He is likely the same man who later signed Nehemiah's covenant.

anan.title: Anan
anan.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
anan.note: He put his name to the sealed covenant by which the community back from exile bound itself to keep the law of Moses under Nehemiah.

ananiah-2.title: Ananiah
ananiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ananiah-2.note: Named once, at Nehemiah 3:23. The same name belongs to a town in Benjamin, commonly identified with Beit Hanina, a few miles north of Jerusalem.

anathoth.title: Anathoth
anathoth.note: A priestly town in Benjamin, about three miles north of Jerusalem, and Jeremiah's home. He bought a field there as a sign of hope while announcing Jerusalem's fall. The site is identified with the village of Anata.

anathoth-3.title: Anathoth
anathoth-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
anathoth-3.note: One of 3 men called Anathoth. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

arabian.title: Arabian
arabian.note: Desert peoples from south and east of Israel. They brought tribute to Jehoshaphat, and in Jehoram's reign they helped the Philistines raid Judah.

arah.title: Arah
arah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
arah.note: He headed a family among the returning exiles. His descendant Shecaniah's daughter married Tobiah, the Ammonite official who opposed Nehemiah's rebuilding.

arah-3.title: Arah
arah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
arah-3.note: One of 3 men called Arah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

artaxerxes.title: Artaxerxes
artaxerxes.note: He funded Ezra's return to Jerusalem with the temple articles and orders to teach the law, and later sent Nehemiah to rebuild the city's walls. A Persian king backing Judah's restoration.

asaph-4.title: Asaph
asaph-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
asaph-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

asaph.title: Asaph
asaph.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
asaph.note: A Levite David put in charge of one of the temple choirs. Twelve psalms carry his name, Psalm 50 and Psalms 73 to 83, which means either he wrote them or a guild of musicians kept his name for generations.

asshur.title: Asshur
asshur.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
asshur.note: Shem's son, whose name stuck to the land and empire of Assyria on the upper Tigris. Assyria became the great power of the eighth and seventh centuries BC, deported Israel's northern tribes after Samaria fell, and kept threatening Judah.

ater.title: Ater
ater.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ater.note: He headed a family of returning exiles. Ezra's record also lists a family of temple gatekeepers by the same name.

ater-2.title: Ater
ater-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ater-2.note: He heads a family among the returning exiles. A family of gatekeepers carries the same name and is counted separately.

ater-3.title: Ater
ater-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ater-3.note: One of 3 men called Ater. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

azaniah.title: Azaniah
azaniah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
azaniah.note: Father of Jeshua, a Levite who set his seal to the covenant renewed under Nehemiah.

azariah-17.title: Azariah
azariah-17.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
azariah-17.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

azariah-4.title: Azariah
azariah-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
azariah-4.note: An Azariah in Nehemiah's lists, at 7:7, 10:2 and 12:33. The name was common and nothing more is known of him.

azariah-9.title: Azariah
azariah-9.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
azariah-9.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him twice.

azbuk.title: Azbuk
azbuk.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
azbuk.note: There are two Nehemiahs, and Azbuk fathered the other one, who ruled half the district of Beth-zur and repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall. He is there only to name his son.

azgad.title: Azgad
azgad.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
azgad.note: A large family among the returning exiles carried his name, listed by household in Ezra and Nehemiah both.

azgad-2.title: Azgad
azgad-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
azgad-2.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

azur-3.title: Azur
azur-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
azur-3.note: He signed the covenant under Nehemiah, and that is all the record holds of him. The name, properly Azzur, means he that assists.

baanah-3.title: Baanah
baanah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
baanah-3.note: One of 4 men called Baanah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named twice in Ezra and Nehemiah.

baanah-4.title: Baanah
baanah-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
baanah-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

babel.title: Babel
babel.note: The plain in Shinar where people, still speaking one language after the flood, set out to build a city and a tower reaching to the heavens and make a name for themselves. God answered by confusing their language.

bakbuk.title: Bakbuk
bakbuk.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bakbuk.note: The name means bottle or flask. His descendants were temple servants, Nethinim, who came back from Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel.

bani.title: Bani
bani.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bani.note: A common name after the return, carried by several Levites and returning exiles in Ezra and Nehemiah. This one appears at Nehemiah 8:7 and twice in chapter 9.

bani-10.title: Bani
bani-10.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bani-10.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

bani-7.title: Bani
bani-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bani-7.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

bani-9.title: Bani
bani-9.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bani-9.note: One of 10 men called Bani. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

barkos.title: Barkos
barkos.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
barkos.note: His family were temple servants, Nethinim, who came back from Babylonian exile but could not prove their Israelite descent from the records.

baruch-2.title: Baruch
baruch-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
baruch-2.note: One of 4 men called Baruch. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

baruch-4.title: Baruch
baruch-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
baruch-4.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

barzillai.title: Barzillai
barzillai.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
barzillai.note: When David fled from Absalom, this old and wealthy Gileadite fed him and his men. David later offered him a place at court. Barzillai turned it down.

bashan.title: Bashan
bashan.note: The fertile tableland east of the Jordan, between Gilead and Mount Hermon. Og ruled it, the last of the Rephaim, until Israel beat him and gave the land to half the tribe of Manasseh.

bavai.title: Bavai
bavai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bavai.note: He ruled the district of Keilah and repaired a section of Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah, and he was Henadad's son.

bazlith.title: Bazlith
bazlith.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bazlith.note: Also spelled Bazluth. His family of temple servants, Nethinim, came back from Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel, and nothing further is recorded about him.

bebai.title: Bebai
bebai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bebai.note: Head of a family among the returning exiles, and prominent enough to be among those who sealed Nehemiah's covenant renewal.

bebai-2.title: Bebai
bebai-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bebai-2.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

beeroth.title: Beeroth
beeroth.note: It was one of four Hivite cities, with Gibeon, Chephirah and Kiriath-jearim. Their people tricked Joshua into a peace treaty by dressing up as travellers from far away. Later it was allotted to Benjamin.

beninu.title: Beninu
beninu.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
beninu.note: A Levite who sealed the covenant under Nehemiah after the return from exile. He is named only in that list of signers.

benjamin-5.title: Benjamin
benjamin-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
benjamin-5.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

berachiah-2.title: Berachiah
berachiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
berachiah-2.note: A man of the return from exile, named three times in Nehemiah, at 3:4, 3:30 and 6:18.

besai.title: Besai
besai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
besai.note: His descendants were temple servants, Nethinim, among those who returned from Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel.

besodeiah.title: Besodeiah
besodeiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
besodeiah.note: His son repaired the old gate in Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah, and Besodeiah is named as the father.

beth-el.title: Beth-el
beth-el.note: About ten miles north of Jerusalem, and once the Canaanite city of Luz. Abram built an altar there. Jacob dreamed of a ladder reaching to heaven there and called the place house of God.

beth-zur.title: Beth-zur
beth-zur.note: A fortified town in the hill country of Judah, a few miles north of Hebron. Rehoboam strengthened it as part of the defences of his kingdom once the ten northern tribes had broken away.

bethaz-maveth.title: Bethaz-maveth
bethaz-maveth.note: House of Azmaveth, a town near Jerusalem whose people are counted among the returning exiles in Nehemiah's list.

bethlehem.title: Bethlehem
bethlehem.note: House of bread. It is a small town about five miles south of Jerusalem, earlier called Ephrath, where Rachel died and was buried and where Ruth gleaned in Boaz's fields. David was born there and anointed there.

bezai.title: Bezai
bezai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bezai.note: He headed a family among the returning exiles and signed Nehemiah's covenant renewal.

bezai-2.title: Bezai
bezai-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bezai-2.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

bigvai.title: Bigvai
bigvai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bigvai.note: They came back with Zerubbabel, the family Bigvai headed, and he later signed Nehemiah's covenant renewal.

bigvai-2.title: Bigvai
bigvai-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bigvai-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

bigvai-3.title: Bigvai
bigvai-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bigvai-3.note: One of 3 men called Bigvai. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

bilgai.title: Bilgai
bilgai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bilgai.note: Bilgah under a variant spelling, a priest who set his seal to the covenant under Nehemiah.

bilshan.title: Bilshan
bilshan.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bilshan.note: One of the leaders who came back to Judah from Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel around 538 BC. His name means something like eloquent, or man of the tongue.

binnui.title: Binnui
binnui.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
binnui.note: A common Levitical name. Men called Binnui turn up among the wall builders under Nehemiah and among the men confronted over foreign marriages under Ezra.

binnui-4.title: Binnui
binnui-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
binnui-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

bunni.title: Bunni
bunni.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bunni.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

bunni-3.title: Bunni
bunni-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bunni-3.note: This Bunni was among those who signed Nehemiah's covenant renewal and helped lead worship after the law was read out.

canaanite.title: Canaanite
canaanite.note: They were the people living in the land promised to Israel. The biblical genealogy traces them to Canaan, son of Ham. The Old Testament repeatedly orders them driven out because of their idol worship and other practices.

canan-2.title: Canan
canan-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
canan-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

canan-3.title: Canan
canan-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
canan-3.note: A name in the family lists, carried by a man named once.

canan-7.title: Canan
canan-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
canan-7.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

canan-8.title: Canan
canan-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
canan-8.note: One of 9 men called Canan. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

chaldeans.title: Chaldeans
chaldeans.note: They started as one tribal group in southern Mesopotamia and ended up ruling the whole Babylonian empire. In the Old Testament the name came to mean Babylonians in general.

chenani.title: Chenani
chenani.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
chenani.note: A Levite who stood on the stairs with others and cried out to the LORD in the great public confession of Nehemiah 9, after the Law had been read. Nothing further is recorded of him.

chephirah.title: Chephirah
chephirah.note: With Gibeon, Beeroth and Kiriath-jearim, one of the four Hivite towns whose people tricked Joshua into a peace treaty by posing as travellers from a far country.

cherub.title: Cherub
cherub.note: A place in Babylonia, not the winged beings. With Tel-harsa and Addan it was one of the settlements some returning exiles came from who could not prove their descent.

chisleu.title: Chisleu
chisleu.note: Ninth month, late November into December, also spelled Kislev and taken from the Babylonian calendar.

col-hozeh-2.title: Col-hozeh
col-hozeh-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
col-hozeh-2.note: His son Shallun repaired the Fountain Gate and a stretch of wall in Nehemiah's rebuilding. He was of Judah, and a descendant named Baruch shows up among Jerusalem's returned residents.

dalaiah.title: Dalaiah
dalaiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
dalaiah.note: Named in the returnee lists of Ezra 2 and Nehemiah 7, a family head from after the exile. It was a common name in that period, and the record gives this one nothing more.

dalaiah-5.title: Dalaiah
dalaiah-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
dalaiah-5.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

daniel-2.title: Daniel
daniel-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
daniel-2.note: One of 3 men called Daniel. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named twice in Ezra and Nehemiah.

darkon.title: Darkon
darkon.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
darkon.note: His descendants came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel among the servants of Solomon, a class of temple workers.

david.title: David
david.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
david.note: The shepherd from Bethlehem who killed Goliath and became Israel's second king, ruling the largest territory Israel ever held, which Solomon then inherited. Solomon was one of his sons. Nearly half the psalms carry his name, and the Tel Dan inscription, where an enemy king boasts over the house of David, put his dynasty outside the Bible as well.

egypt.title: Egypt
egypt.note: Joseph rose to power there and kept his family alive through the famine. A later pharaoh enslaved their descendants, and that set up the exodus. For the rest of the Old Testament Egypt stands for the slavery Israel was brought out of, and Matthew has Jesus's family flee there from Herod as if living that story again.

elam-2.title: Elam
elam-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
elam-2.note: The head of a family that came back from Babylon, counted in Ezra 2 and Nehemiah 7. Some of his descendants were in the foreign-marriage list of Ezra 10.

elam-6.title: Elam
elam-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
elam-6.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

eliashib-2.title: Eliashib
eliashib-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
eliashib-2.note: In Nehemiah 3 he is the high priest who started the wall work with his fellow priests, and the stretch by his house is used to mark where others built.

elul.title: Elul
elul.note: Sixth month, August into September, and Nehemiah finished the wall in it.

ephraim.title: Ephraim
ephraim.about: Joseph's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
ephraim.note: Joseph's younger son. When Jacob blessed the two boys he crossed his hands on purpose and gave Ephraim the bigger blessing over Manasseh. The tribe came to dominate the north so much that the prophets use Ephraim for the whole northern kingdom.

ezer-6.title: Ezer
ezer-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ezer-6.note: A Levite who repaired a stretch of Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah.

ezra.title: Ezra
ezra.about: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
ezra.note: The priest and scribe who led a second return from exile, from Babylon to Jerusalem. In Nehemiah 8 he reads the law aloud to the whole assembled people, and they weep.

gaba.title: Gaba
gaba.note: Another English spelling of Geba, a Levitical city in Benjamin by the pass of Michmash. Jonathan raided a Philistine garrison there, and later it marked the line between the northern and southern kingdoms.

gahar.title: Gahar
gahar.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
gahar.note: They came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel, the descendants of Gahar, one of the families of temple servants called the Nethinim.

gazzam.title: Gazzam
gazzam.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
gazzam.note: Temple servants, the Nethinim, who came home from Babylon with Zerubbabel, counted under his name. Nothing further is known of him.

geshem.title: Geshem
geshem.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
geshem.note: An Arab official. With Sanballat and Tobiah he mocked Nehemiah and tried to stop the walls of Jerusalem going back up.

gibeon.title: Gibeon
gibeon.note: They tricked Joshua into a treaty by dressing as travellers from far away, the Hivites of this city northwest of Jerusalem, and so they lived but served at Israel's sanctuary. The tabernacle stood at Gibeon for years, and Solomon had his dream there. At el-Jib dozens of jar handles stamped with the name have settled where it was.

gibeonite.title: Gibeonite
gibeonite.note: Saul broke the old treaty and killed some of them. Under David a famine followed, and it ended only when seven of Saul's descendants were handed over to the Gibeonites for execution.

giddel.title: Giddel
giddel.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
giddel.note: Head of a family of temple servants, the Nethinim, in the lists of exiles coming home.

giddel-2.title: Giddel
giddel-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
giddel-2.note: Head of a family among the temple servants, and separately among Solomon's servants, both counted in the return lists.

gileadite.title: Gileadite
gileadite.note: Someone from Gilead, east of the Jordan, or of the clan named after Machir's son. Jephthah is the best known, the judge who beat the Ammonites and made the rash vow about his daughter.

ginnetho.title: Ginnetho
ginnetho.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ginnetho.note: A priest who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel, and his family is one of the priestly houses Nehemiah lists.

girgashite.title: Girgashite
girgashite.note: Descended from Canaan in Genesis 10, and one of the peoples on the list Israel was to drive out. Where exactly they lived is unclear, though they are generally placed in the central hill country.

habaiah.title: Habaiah
habaiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
habaiah.note: His family were priests who came back from Babylon and could not prove their descent from Aaron. They were kept out of the priesthood until a high priest could settle it with the Urim and Thummim, and the record never says that happened.

hachaliah.title: Hachaliah
hachaliah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hachaliah.note: Nehemiah's father, and that is the only reason he is named.

hadid.title: Hadid
hadid.note: Exiles back from Babylon resettled it, a Benjamin town grouped with Lod and Ono in the lists. It is el-Haditheh, a few miles east of Lydda.

hagaba.title: Hagaba
hagaba.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hagaba.note: Hagabah in Nehemiah's copy of the list. The family were temple servants, the Nethinim, home from exile with Zerubbabel.

hakupha.title: Hakupha
hakupha.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hakupha.note: They were temple servants, the Nethinim, back from Babylon with Zerubbabel around 538 BC, and they are counted under his name. Nothing is known of Hakupha beyond the listing.

hallohesh.title: Hallohesh
hallohesh.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hallohesh.note: He set his seal on Nehemiah's covenant to keep God's law. Shallum, his son or descendant, helped repair the wall of Jerusalem.

hananeel.title: Hananeel
hananeel.note: A tower on Jerusalem's north wall. Nehemiah lists it among the stretches rebuilt, and Jeremiah and Zechariah use it as a landmark when they describe the city to come.

hanani-3.title: Hanani
hanani-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hanani-3.note: One of 5 men called Hanani. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named twice in Nehemiah.

hananiah-10.title: Hananiah
hananiah-10.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hananiah-10.note: One of 15 men called Hananiah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

hananiah-13.title: Hananiah
hananiah-13.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hananiah-13.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once. The verse is Nehemiah 3:30.

hananiah-14.title: Hananiah
hananiah-14.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hananiah-14.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him. The verse is Nehemiah 3:8.

hananiah-15.title: Hananiah
hananiah-15.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hananiah-15.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

hanun-2.title: Hanun
hanun-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hanun-2.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

hanun-3.title: Hanun
hanun-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hanun-3.note: One of 3 men called Hanun. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

harhaiah.title: Harhaiah
harhaiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
harhaiah.note: Uzziel the goldsmith worked on the wall by the Old Gate, and Harhaiah was his father.

harhur.title: Harhur
harhur.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
harhur.note: His name means fever. His descendants were temple servants, Nethinim, who came back with Zerubbabel, and nothing more is known of him.

harim.title: Harim
harim.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
harim.note: The third priestly course in 1 Chronicles 24:8 went by this name, and the family came back from exile. Some of them were among the men Ezra confronted for marrying foreign wives.

harim-2.title: Harim
harim-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
harim-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

harim-3.title: Harim
harim-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
harim-3.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

harim-4.title: Harim
harim-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
harim-4.note: One of 4 men called Harim. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

hariph.title: Hariph
hariph.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hariph.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

hariph-2.title: Hariph
hariph-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hariph-2.note: A family head, also called Jorah, whose descendants came back from exile with Zerubbabel. The name is also among those who sealed Nehemiah's covenant.

harsha.title: Harsha
harsha.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
harsha.note: Temple servants, Nethinim, back from Babylon with Zerubbabel, and his family was one of them. The name means worker, or possibly enchanter.

harumaph.title: Harumaph
harumaph.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
harumaph.note: Named only so his son Jedaiah can be told apart. Jedaiah rebuilt the stretch of Jerusalem's wall opposite his own house.

hasbadana.title: Hasbadana
hasbadana.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hasbadana.note: When Ezra read the law from the wooden platform, he was one of the men standing beside him. Nothing further is recorded about him.

hashabiah.title: Hashabiah
hashabiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hashabiah.note: He served in Ezra's day; the name was a common Levitical one, carried by musicians, officials and administrators over several generations.

hashabiah-10.title: Hashabiah
hashabiah-10.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hashabiah-10.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

hashabnah.title: Hashabnah
hashabnah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hashabnah.note: He sealed the covenant Nehemiah led the returned exiles to make, and that is all.

hashabniah.title: Hashabniah
hashabniah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hashabniah.note: Hattush, one of the men repairing Jerusalem's wall, was his son. Another Hashabniah of the same time was a Levite who helped lead the public confession.

hashabniah-2.title: Hashabniah
hashabniah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hashabniah-2.note: A Levite who helped lead Israel in confession and prayer after the law was read out.

hashub-2.title: Hashub
hashub-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hashub-2.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

hashub-3.title: Hashub
hashub-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hashub-3.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

hashub-4.title: Hashub
hashub-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hashub-4.note: One of 4 men called Hashub. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

hashum.title: Hashum
hashum.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hashum.note: Head of a family among the exiles who came back. Ezra 10:33 lists men of his family who had married foreign wives.

hashum-2.title: Hashum
hashum-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hashum-2.note: One of 3 men called Hashum. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

hashum-3.title: Hashum
hashum-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hashum-3.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

hashupha.title: Hashupha
hashupha.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hashupha.note: Also spelled Hasupha. His family were Nethinim, temple servants, and they came back in the first group from Babylon. Nothing further is recorded about him.

hatipha.title: Hatipha
hatipha.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hatipha.note: Of the Nethinim, the temple servants. His family came back from exile to Jerusalem.

hatita.title: Hatita
hatita.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hatita.note: Gatekeepers of the temple. His family held the post and came back from exile with Zerubbabel.

hattil.title: Hattil
hattil.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hattil.note: Among Solomon's servants, temple workers whose families came back with Zerubbabel, his was one. Nothing further is recorded about him.

hattush.title: Hattush
hattush.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hattush.note: The Hattush in these verses is a priest, listed once among the men who sealed Nehemiah's covenant and once among the priests who came back. The note about David's descendant who came with Ezra fits a different man.

hattush-4.title: Hattush
hattush-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hattush-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

henadad.title: Henadad
henadad.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
henadad.note: His Levitical family helped oversee the temple rebuilding under Zerubbabel and, a generation on, the walls under Nehemiah.

henadad-2.title: Henadad
henadad-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
henadad-2.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

henadad-3.title: Henadad
henadad-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
henadad-3.note: One of 3 men called Henadad. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

heshbon.title: Heshbon
heshbon.note: Sihon's capital, east of the Jordan near the northern edge of Moab. Moses took it before Israel crossed into Canaan, and it became a Levitical city in Reuben. Moab later had it back, which is why the prophets name it in their judgments on Moab, and the ruins, still called Hesban, lie about twenty miles east of the Jordan.

hezekiah-2.title: Hezekiah
hezekiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hezekiah-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

hezekiah-3.title: Hezekiah
hezekiah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hezekiah-3.note: One of 4 men called Hezekiah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

hezir-2.title: Hezir
hezir-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hezir-2.note: A leader who sealed Nehemiah's covenant. The seventeenth priestly division under David carries the name too.

hillkiah-7.title: Hillkiah
hillkiah-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hillkiah-7.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

hittite.title: Hittite
hittite.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
hittite.note: Ephron the Hittite sold Abraham the cave of Machpelah at Hebron, and Uriah, the soldier whose wife David took, was a Hittite too. Critics once doubted there was ever a Hittite nation, until digs at Boghazkoy in Turkey found its capital. The Hittites in Canaan were probably a smaller offshoot, or the name used loosely.

hodevah.title: Hodevah
hodevah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hodevah.note: Another spelling of Hodaviah. He headed a family of Levites that came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel.

hodijah.title: Hodijah
hodijah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hodijah.note: The name turns up among those who helped the people understand the law after Ezra read it out, and again among the signers of the covenant under Nehemiah; it was a common Levitical name.

hodijah-2.title: Hodijah
hodijah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hodijah-2.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

hodijah-3.title: Hodijah
hodijah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hodijah-3.note: One of 3 men called Hodijah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

horonite.title: Horonite
horonite.note: Sanballat's label, and the man was one of Nehemiah's chief opponents over the wall. It probably means he came from Horonaim in Moab or from one of the Beth-horons. The Elephantine papyri name him as governor of Samaria.

hoshea-2.title: Hoshea
hoshea-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hoshea-2.note: One of 4 men called Hoshea. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

hur-3.title: Hur
hur-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hur-3.note: One of 3 men called Hur. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

immer-3.title: Immer
immer-3.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and nothing else is recorded.

immer.title: Immer
immer.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
immer.note: Head of one of David's twenty-four priestly divisions, and his family name comes back with the returning exiles.

immer-4.title: Immer
immer-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
immer-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

imri-2.title: Imri
imri-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
imri-2.note: Father of Zaccur, who repaired a stretch of the wall under Nehemiah.

israel.title: Israel
israel.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
israel.note: God gave Jacob this name after he wrestled through the night at Peniel. It became the name of the nation that came from his twelve sons, and later of the northern kingdom and of the land. For the man himself, see Jacob.

jaala.title: Jaala
jaala.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jaala.note: His family were among the Nethinim, the temple servants, who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel.

jaddua-2.title: Jaddua
jaddua-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jaddua-2.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

jadon.title: Jadon
jadon.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jadon.note: He came from Meronoth and worked on Jerusalem's wall beside the men of Gibeon and Mizpah when Nehemiah rebuilt it. Nothing further is recorded about him.

jamin-3.title: Jamin
jamin-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jamin-3.note: One of 3 men called Jamin. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

jedaiah-2.title: Jedaiah
jedaiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jedaiah-2.note: The second priestly division in Chronicles carries his name, and his descendants are counted among the priests who came back from Babylon.

jedaiah-6.title: Jedaiah
jedaiah-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jedaiah-6.note: A priestly name, common after the exile; this one helped repair the wall.

jehohanan-8.title: Jehohanan
jehohanan-8.about: Ammonite living at the time of Exile and Return
jehohanan-8.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

jehoiada-6.title: Jehoiada
jehoiada-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jehoiada-6.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

jeremiah-2.title: Jeremiah
jeremiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jeremiah-2.note: Not the prophet. This Jeremiah is a priest in Nehemiah: he came back from Babylon with the first returns, his name stands on the covenant in Nehemiah 10, and his family is still counted among the priestly houses a generation on.

jericho.title: Jericho
jericho.note: Israel crossed the Jordan and Jericho was the first city it took, walled and gated, with its own king. Achan died for what he stole from the plunder there, a Babylonian robe and silver that belonged to God. By then the place was already ancient: digging at the site has turned up remains about ten thousand years old.

jerusalem.title: Jerusalem
jerusalem.note: David took it from the Jebusites and made it his capital, and once Solomon's temple stood there it was the centre of Israel's worship for a thousand years. Babylon destroyed it, the exiles rebuilt it, Rome destroyed it again in AD 70. Jesus died and rose just outside its walls, and Revelation ends with a new Jerusalem coming down from heaven.

jeshanah.title: Jeshanah
jeshanah.note: Abijah of Judah captured this northern town from Jeroboam, with Bethel and Ephron, in a battle Judah won though badly outnumbered. It is generally identified with Burj el-Isaneh, north of Bethel. Nehemiah's Jeshanah gate in Jerusalem is a different thing.

jeshua-2.title: Jeshua
jeshua-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeshua-2.note: One of the priestly houses, in the temple rota of Chronicles and again among the priests who came back from Babylon in Ezra and Nehemiah.

jeshua.title: Jeshua
jeshua.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jeshua.note: Joshua, shortened the way people said it after the exile. The man who carries it furthest is Jeshua son of Jozadak, the high priest who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel and rebuilt the altar and then the temple. Haggai and Zechariah call him Joshua and set him beside Zerubbabel as a picture of the coming priest-king.

jeshua-3.title: Jeshua
jeshua-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jeshua-3.note: One of 8 men called Jeshua. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named twice in Ezra and Nehemiah.

jeshua-8.title: Jeshua
jeshua-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jeshua-8.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

jew.title: Jew
jew.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
jew.note: The word comes from Judah. At first it meant someone from the kingdom of Judah, and after the exile it came to cover the whole covenant people descended from Abraham, whatever tribe they came from.

joab-2.title: Joab
joab-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
joab-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

josabad-9.title: Josabad
josabad-9.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
josabad-9.note: One of David's elite soldiers, and one of those who came over to him while he was still running from Saul.

judah.title: Judah
judah.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
judah.note: Leah's fourth son, and the brother who ends up leading. He talked the others into selling Joseph rather than killing him, and later offered himself as a hostage in Benjamin's place. His tribe produced David's royal line and gave its name to the southern kingdom, and Jacob's dying blessing promised the sceptre would not leave him.

kadmiel.title: Kadmiel
kadmiel.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
kadmiel.note: A Levite who led worship and helped oversee the rebuilding when the exiles came back, under Zerubbabel and later under Nehemiah.

keilah.title: Keilah
keilah.note: David saved this walled town from a Philistine raid while Saul was hunting him. Then he learned they would have handed him over if Saul came, and he moved on into the wilderness of Ziph.

kelita.title: Kelita
kelita.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
kelita.note: The law was read out in public, and he was one of the Levites who explained it to the people. He also signed the covenant renewal under Nehemiah.

keros.title: Keros
keros.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
keros.note: Ancestor of a family of temple servants, the Nethinim, who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel.

koz.title: Koz
koz.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
koz.note: Ancestor of a priestly family that came back from exile and could not prove its descent, and until that was settled they were kept out of the priesthood.

lebana.title: Lebana
lebana.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
lebana.note: Ancestor of a family of temple servants, the Nethinim, who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel.

lod.title: Lod
lod.note: They called it Lydda in New Testament Greek. Over seven hundred people came back from exile to this town of Benjamin, on the plain along the road from Jerusalem to Joppa. Modern Lod, by Tel Aviv's airport, keeps the name.

maaseiah-14.title: Maaseiah
maaseiah-14.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
maaseiah-14.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return. The verse is Nehemiah 10:25.

maaseiah-19.title: Maaseiah
maaseiah-19.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
maaseiah-19.note: One of 20 men called Maaseiah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah. The verse is Nehemiah 3:23.

maaseiah-20.title: Maaseiah
maaseiah-20.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
maaseiah-20.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him. The verse is Nehemiah 8:4.

maaseiah-21.title: Maaseiah
maaseiah-21.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
maaseiah-21.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once. The verse is Nehemiah 8:7.

maaziah-2.title: Maaziah
maaziah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
maaziah-2.note: A priest who sealed Nehemiah's covenant. The twenty-fourth priestly division carries the name too.

magpiash.title: Magpiash
magpiash.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
magpiash.note: His name is on the covenant Nehemiah's leaders sealed after the exile, and nothing else about him survives.

malchijah-10.title: Malchijah
malchijah-10.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
malchijah-10.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

malchijah-11.title: Malchijah
malchijah-11.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
malchijah-11.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

malchijah-6.title: Malchijah
malchijah-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
malchijah-6.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return. The verse is Nehemiah 10:3.

malchijah-8.title: Malchijah
malchijah-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
malchijah-8.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return. The verse is Nehemiah 3:11.

malchijah-9.title: Malchijah
malchijah-9.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
malchijah-9.note: One of 12 men called Malchijah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah. The verse is Nehemiah 3:14.

malluch.title: Malluch
malluch.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
malluch.note: One of those who signed the covenant renewal under Nehemiah, carrying a name common among the priests after the exile.

malluch-5.title: Malluch
malluch-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
malluch-5.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

mattithiah-n-4.title: Mattithiah
mattithiah-n-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mattithiah-n-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

meah.title: Meah
meah.note: The Tower of the Hundred, on Jerusalem's north wall. The priests rebuilt it when Nehemiah restored the city's defences after the exile, and the name probably came from its height in cubits or a measure of the wall beside it.

mehetabeel-2.title: Mehetabeel
mehetabeel-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mehetabeel-2.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

mehida.title: Mehida
mehida.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mehida.note: Head of a family of Nethinim, temple servants whose descendants came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel. That is all that survives.

melatiah.title: Melatiah
melatiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
melatiah.note: A Gibeonite who worked on Jerusalem's wall in Nehemiah's day, alongside the men of Gibeon and Mizpah.

meremoth.title: Meremoth
meremoth.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meremoth.note: The priest who helped weigh the gold and silver vessels Ezra brought back from Babylon. Later he repaired a stretch of Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah.

meronothite.title: Meronothite
meronothite.note: From Meronoth, wherever that was. Jehdeiah the Meronothite kept David's donkeys, and generations later Jadon the Meronothite helped repair Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah.

meshezabeel.title: Meshezabeel
meshezabeel.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshezabeel.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

meshezabeel-3.title: Meshezabeel
meshezabeel-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshezabeel-3.note: One verse, Nehemiah 3:4, in the record of who repaired which part of Jerusalem's wall.

meshullam.title: Meshullam
meshullam.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshullam.note: Priests, Levites and officials all used this name after the exile. Several of them worked on Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah or in running the temple.

meshullam-14.title: Meshullam
meshullam-14.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshullam-14.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him. The verse is Nehemiah 10:20.

meshullam-19.title: Meshullam
meshullam-19.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshullam-19.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return. The verse is Nehemiah 3:6.

meshullam-2.title: Meshullam
meshullam-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshullam-2.note: Nehemiah names him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

meshullam-20.title: Meshullam
meshullam-20.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshullam-20.note: One of 20 men called Meshullam. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah. The verse is Nehemiah 8:4.

miamin.title: Miamin
miamin.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
miamin.note: The name of a priestly family listed under Nehemiah, and common among priests after the exile.

micha-2.title: Micha
micha-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
micha-2.note: One of 4 men called Micha. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

mikmas.title: Mikmas
mikmas.note: Michmash, a town in Benjamin north of Jerusalem. The Philistines gathered there against Saul, and Jonathan and his armour-bearer climbed across a rocky ravine to attack their garrison, which set off a rout. Isaiah pictures the Assyrian army leaving its baggage there, and families from Michmash came back from Babylon.

miphkad.title: Miphkad
miphkad.note: The Muster Gate, one of Jerusalem's gates, repaired when Nehemiah rebuilt the wall. It probably stood near the northeast corner of the temple area.

mishael-3.title: Mishael
mishael-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mishael-3.note: One of 3 men called Mishael. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

mispereth.title: Mispereth
mispereth.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mispereth.note: He came back from Babylon among the leaders with Zerubbabel and Jeshua. Ezra's list spells him Mizpar.

mordecai-2.title: Mordecai
mordecai-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mordecai-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

moses.title: Moses
moses.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
moses.note: Born a Hebrew slave in Egypt and raised in Pharaoh's house, he killed an Egyptian overseer and ran to Midian, where he kept sheep for forty years. God called him back from the burning bush to face Pharaoh and lead Israel out. He gave them the law at Sinai, led them forty years in the wilderness, and died at a hundred and twenty within sight of the promised land.

nahamani.title: Nahamani
nahamani.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
nahamani.note: Among the leaders who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel, in Nehemiah 7:7, and nothing more is told of him.

nebai.title: Nebai
nebai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
nebai.note: One of the family heads who set their seal to the covenant under Nehemiah. Nothing more is recorded.

nebo-2.title: Nebo
nebo-2.note: The other Nebo, a town in Benjamin. A family from it came back from exile with Zerubbabel.

nebuchadnezzar.title: Nebuchadnezzar
nebuchadnezzar.about: Emperor living at the time of Divided Monarchy
nebuchadnezzar.note: King of Babylon. He destroyed Jerusalem and its temple in 586 BC and carried Judah off, and the Bible still calls him the tool God used to judge his people. Daniel tells how, after boasting of his greatness, he went mad and lived like an animal for seven times, which Daniel never defines, until he gave God the glory and got his throne back.

nehemiah.title: Nehemiah
nehemiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
nehemiah.note: Cupbearer to the Persian king Artaxerxes. He used that trust to get leave, money and safe conduct to rebuild Jerusalem's walls, and finished in fifty-two days against constant sabotage. As governor of Judah he forced debt relief for the poor and took on intermarriage and Sabbath breaking.

nehemiah-2.title: Nehemiah
nehemiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
nehemiah-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

nehemiah-3.title: Nehemiah
nehemiah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
nehemiah-3.note: One of 3 men called Nehemiah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

nehum.title: Nehum
nehum.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
nehum.note: One of the leaders who came back to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel, called Rehum in Ezra's list.

nekoda.title: Nekoda
nekoda.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
nekoda.note: His family were temple servants who came back from exile and could not prove their descent.

nekoda-2.title: Nekoda
nekoda-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
nekoda-2.note: Head of a family among the temple servants who came back from exile and could not prove their descent. Several families had the same problem.

nephisesim.title: Nephisesim
nephisesim.note: A family of Nethinim, the temple servants, back from Babylon with Zerubbabel. Ezra's list spells them Nephusim.

nethinims.title: Nethinims
nethinims.note: Temple servants, probably war captives to begin with, given the heavy work around the Levites. Groups of them come back from Babylon in the return lists.

netophah.title: Netophah
netophah.note: "Dripping," probably for a spring, the name of a town near Bethlehem. Some of its people came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel, and two of David's best soldiers were Netophathites.

neziah.title: Neziah
neziah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
neziah.note: Head of a family of Nethinim, temple servants whose descendants came back with Zerubbabel. Nothing more survives.

nisan.title: Nisan
nisan.note: First month of the religious year, March into April. The older texts call it Abib, and Nehemiah and Esther both date by it.

noadiah-2.title: Noadiah
noadiah-2.about: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return
noadiah-2.note: A prophetess who worked with those trying to frighten Nehemiah off the wall.

non.title: Non
non.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
non.note: Joshua's father, of the tribe of Ephraim, more usually spelled Nun and hardly ever seen outside the phrase "Joshua son of Nun."

obadiah-12.title: Obadiah
obadiah-12.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
obadiah-12.note: One of 12 men called Obadiah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

og.title: Og
og.about: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
og.note: King of Bashan and, in Deuteronomy, the last of the Rephaim, with a bed over thirteen feet long. Israel beat him and took his whole kingdom.

ono.title: Ono
ono.note: Nehemiah's enemies Sanballat and Tobiah asked him four times to come down and meet them in the plain of Ono, and he would not go. The town belonged to Benjamin, in a fertile plain northwest of Jerusalem, and returning exiles settled it again.

ophel.title: Ophel
ophel.note: Temple servants lived on the Ophel, the fortified stretch of Jerusalem between the temple mount and the city of David, while Nehemiah was rebuilding the wall.

padon.title: Padon
padon.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
padon.note: His family were Nethinim, temple servants who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel, and nothing further is recorded about him.

pahathmoab.title: Pahathmoab
pahathmoab.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
pahathmoab.note: A big family among the returning exiles, big enough that Ezra and Nehemiah both list it house by house.

pahathmoab-2.title: Pahathmoab
pahathmoab-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
pahathmoab-2.note: One of 3 men called Pahathmoab. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

pahathmoab-3.title: Pahathmoab
pahathmoab-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
pahathmoab-3.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

palal.title: Palal
palal.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
palal.note: Son of Uzai. When Nehemiah rebuilt the wall of Jerusalem, Palal took the section opposite the corner and the tower that stuck out from the upper palace, by the court of the guard.

parosh.title: Parosh
parosh.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
parosh.note: The family of Parosh heads the list of lay families who came back from exile. A large house, and Ezra puts it first.

parosh-3.title: Parosh
parosh-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
parosh-3.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

parosh-4.title: Parosh
parosh-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
parosh-4.note: One of 4 men called Parosh. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

paseah.title: Paseah
paseah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
paseah.note: He headed one of the families of temple servants who came back from exile.

paseah-3.title: Paseah
paseah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
paseah-3.note: One of 3 men called Paseah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

pashur.title: Pashur
pashur.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
pashur.note: His name heads a family that came back from exile, counted in Ezra 2:38 and Nehemiah 7:41. He is not the temple official who had Jeremiah beaten; that man has his own entry.

pashur-4.title: Pashur
pashur-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
pashur-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

pedaiah-6.title: Pedaiah
pedaiah-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
pedaiah-6.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

pedaiah-7.title: Pedaiah
pedaiah-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
pedaiah-7.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

pelaiah.title: Pelaiah
pelaiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
pelaiah.note: One of the Levites who helped the people understand the law when Ezra read it, and later a signer of the covenant (Nehemiah 8:7; 10:10).

pelatiah-4.title: Pelatiah
pelatiah-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
pelatiah-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

perida.title: Perida
perida.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
perida.note: His family were servants of Solomon, and their descendants, the house of Perida or Peruda, came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel.

perizzite.title: Perizzite
perizzite.note: They come almost every time in a list, paired with the Canaanites, as one of the peoples living in Canaan before Israel arrived.

pethakiah-4.title: Pethakiah
pethakiah-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
pethakiah-4.note: A common name after the exile. This one heads a priestly division.

pharaoh.title: Pharaoh
pharaoh.note: The king Moses stood in front of. God sent Moses to him to bring Israel out of Egypt, and he hardened his heart through plague after plague before he let them go.

pilcha.title: Pilcha
pilcha.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
pilcha.note: He set his seal to Nehemiah's covenant, one of the leaders of the people. That list is the only place he turns up.

raamiah.title: Raamiah
raamiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
raamiah.note: One of the leaders who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel, called Reelaiah in Ezra's list.

ramah.title: Ramah
ramah.note: Samuel's hometown, and where he was buried. The name was common enough that several towns carried it. Jeremiah's Rachel weeping for her children is set here too.

reaia.title: Reaia
reaia.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
reaia.note: The head of a family of temple servants who came back from exile, listed in Ezra 2:47 and Nehemiah 7:50.

rechab-3.title: Rechab
rechab-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
rechab-3.note: One of 3 men called Rechab. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

rehob-4.title: Rehob
rehob-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
rehob-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

rehum-3.title: Rehum
rehum-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
rehum-3.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

rehum-4.title: Rehum
rehum-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
rehum-4.note: One of 4 men called Rehum. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

rephaiah-4.title: Rephaiah
rephaiah-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
rephaiah-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

rezin-2.title: Rezin
rezin-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
rezin-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

samaria.title: Samaria
samaria.note: Omri bought a hill from a man called Shemer and built a capital on it. Samaria took over from Tirzah as the seat of the northern kingdom. Ahab and the kings after him ruled from there.

sanballat.title: Sanballat
sanballat.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sanballat.note: The main enemy Nehemiah faced while the walls of Jerusalem went back up. A Samaritan official, Sanballat mocked the work, plotted attacks, and tried to lure Nehemiah into a trap.

senaah.title: Senaah
senaah.note: Over three thousand of its people came back from exile with Zerubbabel, one of the largest single groups. Later, men from Senaah worked on Jerusalem's Fish Gate.

seraiah-2.title: Seraiah
seraiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
seraiah-2.note: A Seraiah from the years of the return, not the chief priest Nebuchadnezzar executed. The name sits in Ezra 2:2 and again in the Nehemiah lists.

shabbethai-3.title: Shabbethai
shabbethai-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shabbethai-3.note: A Levite who helped explain the law to the people after Ezra read it out, and who was in the middle of the foreign-marriage crisis.

shallum.title: Shallum
shallum.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
shallum.note: He is a Levite of the years after the exile, named at 1 Chronicles 9:17, 9:19 and 9:31 in the lists of those who kept the gates.

shallum-13.title: Shallum
shallum-13.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shallum-13.note: One of 13 men called Shallum. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

shallum-14.title: Shallum
shallum-14.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shallum-14.note: He repaired a stretch of the city wall in Nehemiah 3:15, and nothing else is recorded about him.

shalmai.title: Shalmai
shalmai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shalmai.note: Head of a family of the Nethinim, the temple servants, whose descendants came back from exile with Zerubbabel. Nehemiah 7:48 spells the name Salmai.

shebaniah.title: Shebaniah
shebaniah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shebaniah.note: One of the Levitical leaders of worship after the law was read under Nehemiah, and one of those who signed the covenant that followed.

shebaniah-2.title: Shebaniah
shebaniah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shebaniah-2.note: Nehemiah names him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

shebaniah-4.title: Shebaniah
shebaniah-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shebaniah-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

shecaniah-2.title: Shecaniah
shecaniah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shecaniah-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

shecaniah-7.title: Shecaniah
shecaniah-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shecaniah-7.note: One of 7 men called Shecaniah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

shelemiah-8.title: Shelemiah
shelemiah-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shelemiah-8.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

shema-5.title: Shema
shema-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shema-5.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

shemaiah-2.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shemaiah-2.note: Named in Nehemiah 10:8 among those who sealed the covenant, and again in the priestly lists of Nehemiah 12.

shemaiah-25.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-25.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shemaiah-25.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him. The verse is Nehemiah 3:29.

shemaiah-26.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-26.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shemaiah-26.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

shephatiah.title: Shephatiah
shephatiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shephatiah.note: A family name among the returning exiles in Ezra 2:4 and Nehemiah 7:9. Ezra 8:8 has more of the same family coming back later.

shephatiah-3.title: Shephatiah
shephatiah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shephatiah-3.note: One of 9 men called Shephatiah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named twice in Ezra and Nehemiah.

sherebiah.title: Sherebiah
sherebiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sherebiah.note: A Levite Ezra went out of his way to bring along on the journey back to Jerusalem, because of his skill and standing.

sherebiah-2.title: Sherebiah
sherebiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sherebiah-2.note: A Levite in the Nehemiah lists. He sealed the covenant in Nehemiah 10:12 and appears again among the Levites of Nehemiah 12.

shobai.title: Shobai
shobai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shobai.note: His descendants were temple gatekeepers who came back from exile with Zerubbabel. The name means captor, or captive, and nothing further is recorded of him.

shobek.title: Shobek
shobek.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shobek.note: He set his seal to the covenant under Nehemiah, with the other leaders of the people. Nothing else is recorded of him.

shushan.title: Shushan
shushan.note: The Persian winter capital, east of the Tigris in what is now southwestern Iran, and the Greeks called it Susa. Most of the book of Esther happens here.

sia.title: Sia
sia.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sia.note: Head of a family of temple servants, the Nethinim. His descendants came back from exile with Zerubbabel to serve at the rebuilt temple, and Nehemiah spells him Siaha.

sihon.title: Sihon
sihon.about: King living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
sihon.note: An Amorite king. Israel asked to pass through his land, and he attacked them instead. It cost him his kingdom east of the Jordan.

sinai.title: Sinai
sinai.note: Also called Horeb. Israel camped at the foot of the mountain for about a year after the exodus, and the law came down through Moses here.

sisera-2.title: Sisera
sisera-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sisera-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

solomon.title: Solomon
solomon.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
solomon.note: David and Bathsheba's son, and Israel's third king. He was rushed onto the throne after his half-brother Adonijah tried to take it while David lay dying. Early on he asked God for wisdom.

sophereth.title: Sophereth
sophereth.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sophereth.note: He headed a family of "Solomon's servants," temple workers whose descendants came back from exile with Zerubbabel. Nothing further is recorded about him.

sotai.title: Sotai
sotai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sotai.note: His family were "Solomon's servants," temple workers who came back from exile with Zerubbabel.

tabaoth.title: Tabaoth
tabaoth.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
tabaoth.note: His family came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel among the temple servants, the Nethinim.

talmon.title: Talmon
talmon.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
talmon.note: He headed a family of temple gatekeepers, and his descendants were still keeping the gates after the exile.

tamah.title: Tamah
tamah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
tamah.note: Head of a family of temple servants, the Nethinim, who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel. Some lists spell it Thamah.

tekoite.title: Tekoite
tekoite.note: Someone from Tekoa, the hometown of Amos. The wise woman Joab sent to David about Absalom was a Tekoite, and so were at least two of David's mighty men.

tel-haresha.title: Tel-haresha
tel-haresha.note: One of the places in Babylonia that exiles returned from. The families from there could not prove they were Israelites, and nobody knows where it was.

tel-melah.title: Tel-melah
tel-melah.note: Hill of salt, a place in Babylonia. People who came back from there could not show their Israelite ancestry, and the site is unknown.

thummim.title: Thummim
thummim.note: Paired with the Urim in the high priest's breastpiece, and used the same way, to put a question to God.

tirshatha.title: Tirshatha
tirshatha.note: A Persian word for the governor of Judah, not a name. It is used of Nehemiah, and on one reading of Zerubbabel.

tobiah-2.title: Tobiah
tobiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
tobiah-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

tobiah.title: Tobiah
tobiah.about: Nehemiah's adversary living at the time of Exile and Return
tobiah.note: They called him the Ammonite. With Sanballat he mocked Nehemiah's wall and worked against it, and later a priest gave him a room inside the temple courts, so Nehemiah threw him and his things out.

ur.title: Ur
ur.note: Abraham's family started out from here, Terah leading them toward Canaan. Ur was a big Sumerian city near the mouth of the Euphrates. Leonard Woolley dug it in the 1920s and 1930s and found a royal cemetery full of gold.

uriah-3.title: Uriah
uriah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
uriah-3.note: A man of the return, named as a father in Ezra 8:33 and in Nehemiah's list of the men rebuilding the wall.

uriah-5.title: Uriah
uriah-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
uriah-5.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

urim.title: Urim
urim.note: The Urim and Thummim sat in the high priest's breastpiece. They were used to put yes-or-no questions to God. How they actually worked, nobody knows.

uzai.title: Uzai
uzai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
uzai.note: Father of Palal, who repaired a stretch of Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah.

uzza-2.title: Uzza
uzza-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
uzza-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

uzziel-6.title: Uzziel
uzziel-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
uzziel-6.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

zaccai.title: Zaccai
zaccai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zaccai.note: They counted his family by household when it came back from exile, in Ezra and in Nehemiah.

zaccur-5.title: Zaccur
zaccur-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zaccur-5.note: One of 8 men called Zaccur. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Nehemiah.

zaccur-7.title: Zaccur
zaccur-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zaccur-7.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

zachariah-28.title: Zachariah
zachariah-28.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zachariah-28.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return. The verse is Nehemiah 8:4.

zadok-4.title: Zadok
zadok-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zadok-4.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

zadok-6.title: Zadok
zadok-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zadok-6.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

zadok-7.title: Zadok
zadok-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zadok-7.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Nehemiah is the only book that names him.

zalaph.title: Zalaph
zalaph.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zalaph.note: His son Hanun rebuilt a stretch of the wall under Nehemiah.

zanoah.title: Zanoah
zanoah.note: A town in Judah. Its people repaired one of Jerusalem's gates when Nehemiah rebuilt the walls.

zattu.title: Zattu
zattu.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zattu.note: He was head of a big family that came back from exile, counted by household in both Ezra and Nehemiah.

zattu-2.title: Zattu
zattu-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zattu-2.note: Nehemiah names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

zedekiah-6.title: Zedekiah
zedekiah-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zedekiah-6.note: A man from the exile and the return. Nehemiah names him once.

zerubbabel.title: Zerubbabel
zerubbabel.about: Governor living at the time of Exile and Return
zerubbabel.note: He came from David's line and led the first exiles back from Babylon to Jerusalem. As governor he laid the temple's foundation and, with Haggai and Zechariah pushing, saw it finished.

ziha.title: Ziha
ziha.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ziha.note: Head of a family of temple servants that came back from exile.
